checks: actual transparent, non-focusable native window launches with correct work-area grounding
native hit mask follows rendered alpha while cursor gaze is disabled
global cursor drives the correct upward gaze pose
native action IPC plays and recovers from a complete jump
isolated native drag API, release, and re-grounding work
scaling stays grounded, autonomous running moves, and pause stops movement
settings controls save exact values and reject invalid input
settings and saved position survive a full app restart
quit shuts down the native process

limitations: No Live2D layered source, model or editable motion project yet.
Gaze switches whole existing direction sprites; no independent eye/head parameters.
No audio, complete run-fall/staff/shape-change choreography yet.
